scope: Model Arena whole application and new BYOK grader Configure tab
interpretation: 122 distinct possible failure scenarios, not120 observed defects. Fixed entries scored before mitigation; other entries scored with existing controls. Source inspection/scenario simulation are not executed production proof. No paid calls.

rows.scenario: Grading failure is hidden, horizontally clipped or unreadable in dark theme
rows.evidence: app/page.js: external grade-errors blocks; app/globals.css: theme tokens; root desktop/mobile screenshots
rows.action_or_limit: Persistent container-width error block outside scrolling answers; matching prompt label/details focus link, Configure action, and real light/dark theme tokens.

rows.scenario: Null score entry causes an uncontrolled TypeError
rows.action_or_limit: Reject every non-object score with controlled502.

rows.scenario: A grader returns syntactically invalid JSON
rows.action_or_limit: Show readable error; preserve answers; no retry.

rows.scenario: A grader omits a score for one answer
rows.action_or_limit: Require exactly one score for every anonymous label.

rows.scenario: An oversized reason crashes or bloats a result cell
rows.action_or_limit: Bound reasons to2000 characters before rendering.

rows.scenario: Corrupt saved JSON prevents page startup
rows.action_or_limit: Keep previous browser copy; show export/recovery notification.

rows.scenario: Storage quota rejection disappears before user can act
rows.action_or_limit: Error notices remain until dismissed; export remains available.

rows.scenario: An upload FileReader error loses the selected comparison
rows.action_or_limit: Read completely before applying; onerror notification retains prior state.

rows.scenario: Database initialization failure leaks a pool connection
rows.action_or_limit: Rollback/release/close failed pool; corrected retry succeeds.

rows.scenario: Missing provider body produces a successful empty grade
rows.action_or_limit: Require readable content then validate complete score envelope.

rows.scenario: Provider timeout blocks grading indefinitely
rows.action_or_limit: Abort at45seconds, safe error, no retry.

rows.scenario: Provider429 triggers automatic billable retry
rows.action_or_limit: Exactly one dispatch, explain quota/rate limit.

rows.scenario: Provider503 exposes raw service error or API key
rows.action_or_limit: Never expose raw upstream body; safe HTTP status only.

rows.scenario: Wrong user key401 has no repair path
rows.action_or_limit: Return safe credential guidance and show Configure action.

rows.scenario: Model access denied403 is mistaken for expired app login
rows.action_or_limit: Provider errors remain502; app401 alone expires login.

rows.scenario: Retired/unavailable model404 wipes completed model answers
rows.action_or_limit: Preserve answers and offer another capability preset.

rows.scenario: Provider refuses to judge unsafe input
rows.action_or_limit: Refusal reported as failure, never a fabricated score.

rows.scenario: Provider reaches token limit but emits superficially valid JSON
rows.action_or_limit: Check stop reason before accepting parsed scores.

rows.scenario: Gemini receives OpenAI-only additionalProperties fields
rows.action_or_limit: Project shared JSON Schema into official Gemini legacy shape; introduced during new feature, not historical cause.

rows.scenario: Provider redirects request to another credential destination
rows.action_or_limit: Fixed origins and redirect:error prevent following a redirect.

rows.scenario: Double click Run schedules the same batch twice
rows.action_or_limit: Synchronous ref blocks repeat dispatch before React repaint.

rows.scenario: Double click Grade schedules a duplicate charge
rows.action_or_limit: Ref blocks duplicate local clicks; cross-tab risk tracked separately.

rows.scenario: Old account401 signs out the newly signed-in account
rows.action_or_limit: Epoch check precedes expiration side effect.

rows.scenario: Owner switches while a response JSON body is being parsed
rows.evidence: client-tests/boundaries.test.mjs: identity change during JSON body
rows.action_or_limit: Second epoch check prevents state application.

rows.scenario: Account changes with queued paid jobs remaining
rows.action_or_limit: Queue checks epoch before each dispatch.

rows.scenario: Reference edit leaves a stale score on changed ground truth
rows.action_or_limit: Invalidate grades for that prompt only; preserve generation.

rows.scenario: Grader provider changes while prior request is in flight
rows.action_or_limit: Disable provider/model/key edits while busy.

rows.scenario: A delayed auth refresh overwrites a newer login
rows.action_or_limit: Epoch-bound reads cannot apply after owner change.

rows.scenario: Reload restores a running job as if work resumed
rows.action_or_limit: Convert queued/running to explicit interrupted error.

rows.scenario: Two tabs grade the same prompt and both incur cost
rows.action_or_limit: No cross-tab idempotency. User-initiated requests remain distinct; rate/capacity limits bound impact.

rows.scenario: Import exceeds2MiB and consumes browser memory
rows.action_or_limit: File size checked before read; UTF8 length rechecked in parser.

rows.scenario: 31st prompt creates an unbounded batch
rows.action_or_limit: Thirty-prompt import limit and disabled Add button.

rows.scenario: API request body exceeds512KiB
rows.action_or_limit: Bound Content-Length and actual stream bytes.

rows.scenario: Provider streams more than1MiB despite small Content-Length
rows.action_or_limit: Count decoded chunks, cancel reader over limit.

rows.scenario: Slow request upload occupies a server indefinitely
rows.action_or_limit: Deadline and bounded body apply before parsing.

rows.scenario: A single user exceeds3 concurrent provider jobs
rows.action_or_limit: Per-owner process capacity rejects excess before provider call.

rows.scenario: Saved browser workspace grows beyond4MiB
rows.action_or_limit: Reject write and offer export; limit currently JS string units, not exact disk bytes.

rows.scenario: Database pool grows without limit under load
rows.action_or_limit: Pool max6 and10second connect/15second statement timeouts.

rows.scenario: Random signup emails exhaust database accounts
rows.evidence: lib/auth.js: signup count1000 and IP rate
rows.action_or_limit: Transactional cap1000;10signup/IP/hour.

rows.scenario: Rate-key cardinality grows without cleanup
rows.action_or_limit: Delete old windows and reject over20000 keys.

rows.scenario: Unauthenticated caller spends via grade endpoint
rows.action_or_limit: requireActor before rate/body/provider work.

rows.scenario: Foreign website submits a grading request with cookies
rows.action_or_limit: Exact same-origin plus signed session CSRF.

rows.scenario: A forged or other-session CSRF token is accepted
rows.action_or_limit: HMAC subject-bound token and expiration checks.

rows.scenario: User grader key is persisted or exported with settings
rows.evidence: app/page.js: React graderKey state vs persistence/export
rows.action_or_limit: Key excluded from both explicit save/export objects; root browser checks pending.

rows.scenario: Changing provider sends previous provider key to a different vendor
rows.action_or_limit: Clear key and show state on provider selection.

rows.scenario: Custom endpoint/model allows SSRF with the key
rows.action_or_limit: Fixed origins and provider-specific model allowlists.

rows.scenario: Key contains newline causing header injection
rows.action_or_limit: ASCII visible characters only after outer trim.

rows.scenario: An answer or reason executes injected HTML in browser
rows.action_or_limit: No dangerouslySetInnerHTML, markdown renderer or eval for provider text.

rows.scenario: Model name __proto__ changes score object prototype
rows.action_or_limit: Null-prototype score object; explicit Map labels.

rows.scenario: One owner settles or modifies another owner usage row
rows.action_or_limit: Both usage ID and owner ID required by settlement predicates.

rows.scenario: Prompt edits erase unrelated completed rows
rows.action_or_limit: Invalidate only selected row keys.

rows.scenario: Grader configuration edits erase expensive model answers
rows.action_or_limit: Configuration invalidates grades only.

rows.scenario: Import object prompt silently becomes [object Object]
rows.action_or_limit: Require actual string fields; no String coercion.

rows.scenario: Numeric imported reference silently becomes a different comparison
rows.action_or_limit: Prompt and reference must be strings.

rows.scenario: Delimiter-containing prompt ID invalidates other row results
rows.action_or_limit: Reject separator/control characters in imported IDs.

rows.scenario: Duplicate imported IDs overwrite unrelated result keys
rows.action_or_limit: Reject entire import before replacing state.

rows.scenario: Successful HF billing is lost when answer shape fails
rows.evidence: tests/backend.test.mjs: successful usage persists before content validation
rows.action_or_limit: Settle known usage before validating display content.

rows.scenario: A failure after budget reservation releases unknown possible spend
rows.action_or_limit: Uncertain reservation retained conservatively.

rows.scenario: Failed schema migration partially changes tables
rows.action_or_limit: Single transaction, rollback on incompatible existing schema.

rows.scenario: Browser storage is cleared and unsynced comparisons disappear
rows.action_or_limit: No cloud workspace sync; warn browser-local and provide exports. Recovery not promised.

rows.scenario: Historical grader failure cannot be diagnosed from retained details
rows.action_or_limit: Historical diagnostic score only: original five uncertain rows cannot identify upstream cause. Future failures now have safe correlated telemetry under ARENA-068; no claim of recovering past data.

rows.scenario: Provider status is hidden by parsing an HTML error body first
rows.action_or_limit: Handle non-2xx status before JSON parse, without exposing body.

rows.scenario: A truncated model answer looks complete to reviewer
rows.action_or_limit: Explain partial answer and token setting, preserve stop marker.

rows.scenario: Fixture scores are mistaken for provider quality validation
rows.action_or_limit: Report session-proxy and prepared modes explicitly; no claims of real model correctness.

rows.scenario: Missing provider usage appears as zero billed tokens
rows.action_or_limit: Normalize unknown to null; do not infer zero cost.

rows.scenario: User assumes entering key validated its billing/access
rows.action_or_limit: Explicit not-yet-verified status; no background validation call.

rows.scenario: Provider key or raw error is included in diagnostic output
rows.action_or_limit: Safe fixed messages; no raw response/body logging.

rows.scenario: Future grader outage has no safe server diagnostic correlation
rows.evidence: tests/grader.test.mjs: telemetry metadata and actual failing grade
rows.action_or_limit: Log fixed event, random request ID, allowlisted provider/model, category and bounded HTTP status only; client receives matching support ID. Existing console collection needs no new service.

rows.scenario: Grader model identity is lost when reviewing results later
rows.action_or_limit: Preserve grader model/provider metadata with result.

rows.scenario: A failed row silently contributes fabricated scores to summary
rows.action_or_limit: Only successful validated grade status contributes; no replacement score.

rows.scenario: 30prompts times3models dispatch90 calls simultaneously
rows.action_or_limit: Three client workers and server capacity bound concurrency.

rows.scenario: Grade all sends30 requests concurrently
rows.action_or_limit: Two grading workers; server per-owner cap3.

rows.scenario: Many users consume every hosted generation dollar
rows.action_or_limit: Transactional shared/owner budget enforcement.

rows.scenario: Multiple app replicas each admit6 calls and exceed intended total
rows.action_or_limit: Single-process assumption; distributed lease needed before replicas.

rows.scenario: Global budget reservations race under concurrent requests
rows.action_or_limit: Serialized transaction covers current totals and insert.

rows.scenario: Usage table reaches100000 rows and budget scan becomes costly
rows.action_or_limit: Fail closed at cap; retention/aggregation plan needed before growth.

rows.scenario: Model catalog refresh stampede calls provider per user
rows.action_or_limit: Per-process pending promise coalesces refreshes.

rows.scenario: Catalog returns3001 HF entries or malformed prices
rows.action_or_limit: Catalog cap and finite price validation before selectable funded route.

rows.scenario: Actual 10x production traffic meets latency/resource target
rows.evidence: No performance/load run in this task
rows.action_or_limit: Local functional QA is not production load testing; no scale claim.

rows.scenario: PostgreSQL outage makes auth health appear normal
rows.action_or_limit: Health check queries DB and returns503; no availability SLA claimed.

rows.scenario: BYOK grading consumes hosted allowance despite using user key
rows.action_or_limit: BYOK bypasses hosted spend ledger; retains rate/capacity limits.

rows.scenario: Unknown BYOK price is displayed as free $0
rows.action_or_limit: Return source user_key,costUSD null; explicit direct billing notice.

rows.scenario: Shared Gemini environment key is used instead of supplied key
rows.action_or_limit: Grade credentials only from current request; no fallback.

rows.scenario: Unpriced HF route is dispatched against hosted allowance
rows.action_or_limit: Fail closed before provider dispatch.

rows.scenario: HF request is dispatched without pinning the quoted provider route
rows.action_or_limit: Pin upstream model:provider to quoted route.

rows.scenario: NaN/negative/infinite route price breaks budget checks
rows.evidence: lib/usage.js: finite and range price guard
rows.action_or_limit: Reject nonfinite or out-of-range prices.

rows.scenario: Provider succeeds but client disconnects before seeing grade
rows.action_or_limit: Provider may charge despite lost response; no refund/replay claim; show retry warning.

rows.scenario: Prepared example unexpectedly starts a paid request
rows.action_or_limit: Canonical server fixture path returns before grade/generate providers.

rows.scenario: A token usage string or negative count produces invalid accounting
rows.action_or_limit: Only nonnegative safe integers accepted; unknown remains null.

rows.scenario: Gemini hidden thinking tokens make displayed output count misleading
rows.action_or_limit: Keep observed reasoning tokens separately; no estimate/billing total inferred.

rows.scenario: Provider network failure retries automatically and doubles cost
rows.action_or_limit: Single fetch per request; no retry loop or SDK retries.

rows.scenario: Manual retry reuses an old error instead of new configuration
rows.action_or_limit: Explicit Grade uses current provider/model/key; old row enters running.

rows.scenario: Reload automatically restarts a previously queued paid request
rows.action_or_limit: No auto-resume; interrupted rows require new user action.

rows.scenario: Click Stop aborts only UI while queue continues spending
rows.action_or_limit: Stop flag prevents new dispatch; button says after current.

rows.scenario: Stop is misunderstood as cancel/refund of active provider calls
rows.action_or_limit: In-flight generation completes; no cancellation/refund guarantee.

rows.scenario: An older FileReader callback replaces a later file or manual edit
rows.evidence: client-tests/grader.test.mjs: competing FileReader and workspace invalidation; app/page.js edit/loadExample/run/grade call sites
rows.action_or_limit: Per-input import generation gates allow only latest selection; manual edit/clear/example/run invalidates pending callbacks.

rows.scenario: A schema failure triggers hidden fallback to another provider
rows.action_or_limit: No fallback provider or hidden second billable attempt.

rows.scenario: Response parser failure rewinds successful generation ledger settlement
rows.action_or_limit: uncertain updates only still-reserved rows.

rows.scenario: Global HTTP middleware repeats POST on a redirect
rows.action_or_limit: Refuse redirects; client routes same-origin only.

rows.scenario: User reloads and loses session-only key, then assumes Grade is broken
rows.evidence: app/page.js: empty-key disabled with Configure CTA
rows.action_or_limit: Configuration explains key lifetime and never silently falls back to shared key.

rows.scenario: Production accidentally runs mock provider mode
rows.action_or_limit: Runtime indicator exposes mock; deployment env still must be independently verified.

rows.scenario: Public deployment enables insecure local-preview bypass
rows.action_or_limit: Local preview requires loopback DB/origin/bind/mock and no provider keys.

rows.scenario: Database URL ssl=no-verify overrides explicit certificate verification
rows.evidence: tests/grader.test.mjs: installed pg TLS override regression
rows.action_or_limit: Remove every case-insensitive ssl-prefixed URL option before constructing pg; preserve explicit CA verification.

rows.scenario: Missing AUTH_SECRET causes insecure default sessions
rows.evidence: tests/backend.test.mjs: missing or short auth config
rows.action_or_limit: Fail closed; no fallback secret.

rows.scenario: Wrong DATABASE_NAME initializes another application database
rows.action_or_limit: Verify current_database in migration transaction.

rows.scenario: Persisted legacy grader model is absent from current presets
rows.action_or_limit: Safe preset default; key must be re-entered.

rows.scenario: OpenAI strict JSON Schema omits additionalProperties false
rows.evidence: tests/grader.test.mjs: fixed endpoint schema; Gemini strict contract
rows.action_or_limit: Shared JSON Schema explicitly closes both object levels.

rows.scenario: Claude request uses retired output_format instead of output_config
rows.action_or_limit: Official current output_config.format JSON schema shape.

rows.scenario: Gemini legacy schema uses noncanonical lowercase enum types
rows.action_or_limit: Uppercase documented enums now; strict mismatch observed, live rejection unproved.

rows.scenario: Changing API key should trigger an unexpected paid validation call
rows.action_or_limit: Only explicit Grade dispatches; no automatic key validation.

rows.scenario: Zero active models allows a meaningless Run
rows.action_or_limit: Show Pick at least one model before queue creation.

rows.scenario: Same model entered twice is compared with itself by duplicate column
rows.action_or_limit: Trim and deduplicate selected identifiers.

rows.scenario: Blank prompt drafts cannot be saved and restored
rows.action_or_limit: Allow blank in saved drafts; exclude blank from execution.

rows.scenario: Subjective preference is treated as objectively proven truth
rows.action_or_limit: Session proxy checks caveats; UI labels scores judgments. Provider behavior unverified.

rows.scenario: Prompt injection inside an answer changes grading rubric
rows.action_or_limit: System rubric treats inputs as data; proxy fixture passes but real-model resistance not established.

rows.scenario: Reference corpus does not contain answer and grader rewards fabrication
rows.action_or_limit: Proxy fixture rewards grounded refusal; provider quality awaits authorized real call.

rows.scenario: Hindi prompt/reference corruption reverses scores
rows.action_or_limit: UTF8 JSON survives adapter/label mapping; actual provider language judgment unverified.

rows.scenario: Empty generated answers are silently omitted from comparison
rows.action_or_limit: Pass empty-answer marker and grade every supplied label.

rows.scenario: CSV model answer executes a spreadsheet formula
rows.action_or_limit: Prefix dangerous leading formula/control sequences; quote CSV syntax.

rows.scenario: Keyboard user cannot reach Configure or know active panel
rows.action_or_limit: Roving tab stop; arrows/Home/End; explicit aria controls/selection. Root browser proof pending.

rows.scenario: Valid JSON scores arrive without explicit terminal completion status
rows.evidence: tests/grader.test.mjs: valid scores without terminal completion
rows.action_or_limit: Require STOP/stop/end_turn for the selected provider before accepting any score.

rows.scenario: Valid persisted JSON contains object children or malformed score values that crash rendering
rows.evidence: client-tests/grader.test.mjs: persisted object children and valid persisted grades
rows.action_or_limit: Allowlist restored result/grade fields; convert unsafe records to recoverable errors; strip unknown fields and unsafe token values; recompute overall score.
